theme.name: Delivery through existing providers and budget
theme.claim: Courses will be delivered by colleges and other adult education providers and funded from the existing Adult Education Budget.

text.line: Courses will be delivered by colleges and other adult education providers, and training will be funded from the existing Adult Education Budget.

theme.name: Consultation on details
theme.claim: The details of the new offer are not yet settled and the government will consult on them in the coming months.

text.line: Government will consult on the details of this new offer in the coming months.
